visual_concept: Illustrate the trade‑off between a raw data lake and a curated data warehouse in a single, clean diagram.
image_prompt: Flat 2D orthographic diagram, deep navy background (#050B14). Centered: two cylinders side by side, left labeled lake, right labeled warehouse. Thin cool‑grey infrastructure lines (#8A99AD) connect: source streams (thin lines) to lake cylinder, lake to processing node (square), processing to warehouse cylinder, warehouse to analytics nodes (small squares). Cyan (#00E5FF) arrows show active data flow from sources to lake, lake to processing, processing to warehouse, warehouse to analytics. White (#FFFFFF) shapes for cylinders, nodes, and arrows. High negative space, clean developer aesthetic, no text, no glow, no 3D, no decorative elements.
negative_prompt: text, labels, numbers, code snippets, UI screenshots, 3D renders, realistic textures, people, rainbow colors, floating icons, duplicate nodes, arbitrary arrows, decorative elements, cyberpunk, excessive glow
accessibility_alt_text: A centered flat 2‑D diagram showing a data lake and a data warehouse side by side, with source streams feeding a raw data lake cylinder, then a processing node, then a warehouse cylinder, and finally analytics nodes, all connected by cyan arrows indicating data flow.
